chosen.premise: Machamp dominates combat with four arms, but those same arms get tangled during delicate work.
chosen.hook: Machamp’s greatest strength becomes its worst weakness.
chosen.visualIdea: Split screen: Machamp overwhelms a foe on one side, then fumbles a tiny precision task on the other.
chosen.note: A genuinely character-specific contradiction: the same four arms enable overwhelming combat but cause failures in delicate work. The cited entries directly support both halves.

candidates.premise: Machamp can launch 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
candidates.hook: Machamp can throw a thousand punches before you blink twice.
candidates.visualIdea: A two-second timer fills while four arms generate a counter racing from 1 to 1,000.
candidates.note: A uniquely Machamp-scale statistic with exact timing and a strong counter animation, though the claim is already familiar to many fans.

candidates.premise: Gigantamax Machamp grows from 1.6 to 25 meters and weighs 1,000 kilograms instead of 130.
candidates.hook: Machamp can grow from a 130-kilogram fighter into a one-ton giant.
candidates.visualIdea: Machamp scales beside a height meter, jumping from 1.6 to 25 meters as its weight changes to 1,000 kilograms.
candidates.note: Excellent measurable transformation with a dramatic height and weight contrast, though it centers on an alternate form rather than standard Machamp.

candidates.premise: One Machamp arm can move mountains, while all four unleash simultaneous punches.
candidates.hook: One of Machamp’s arms is already strong enough to move mountains.
candidates.visualIdea: One arm shoves a mountain aside, then the frame multiplies into four arms attacking and defending together.
candidates.note: Highly visual and extreme, but “move mountains” is a broad Pokédex hyperbole and the evidence does not establish a precise comparison between one-arm strength and four-arm attacks.

candidates.premise: Machamp’s four arms can react faster than it can think, explaining its instant attacks and clumsy precision.
candidates.hook: Machamp’s arms move faster than its brain can think.
candidates.visualIdea: Thought bubbles lag behind four rapidly moving arms, ending with punches landing while Machamp is still deciding.
candidates.note: The speed-versus-precision contrast is distinctive, but the premise that faster-than-thought arms explain its clumsiness is an interpretation rather than a claim directly made by the entries.

candidates.premise: Machamp evolves from Machoke by trade, but Machoke first requires reaching level 28 from Machop.
candidates.hook: Machamp’s final evolution is locked behind a trade.
candidates.visualIdea: A three-step evolution path appears: Machop, level 28, then a trade window transforms Machoke into Machamp.
candidates.note: Accurate and easy to visualize, but trade evolutions are a familiar Pokémon mechanic and the angle is more about progression than Machamp’s identity.

rounds.request: Stronger angles would need a more unexpected Machamp-specific contradiction or rule, anchored by an exact official fact and a visual payoff that is clearer than simply showing its strength.
